name: Hotel Tenne Garni
beschreibung: Hotel Tenne Garni welcomes guests in the center of Söll, delightfully located at the foot of the dramatic Wilder Kaiser range. Offering comfortable bed and breakfast accommodation, the property serves as a welcoming home base for outdoor enthusiasts. A generous breakfast buffet fuels days spent exploring the vast slopes of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental or hiking scenic alpine trails. Cable car stations, cycling routes, and town amenities are all within easy reach, complemented by genuine Tyrolean hospitality.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming Bed & Breakfast hotel in the center of Söll at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser mountains.
